newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: One-month to one-year Saudi t-bill rates rise.
newsitem.headline: One-month to one-year Saudi t-bill rates rise.

text.p: Yields climbed on one-month to one-year Saudi treasury bills worth two billion riyals offered by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency on Tuesday, bankers said.

The yield on 28-day bills, maturing on May 8, rose to 5.6497 percent from 5.5484 last week and the rate on 91-day bills maturing on July 10 rose to 5.7380 from 5.6902. The 182-day bills, maturing on October 9, yielded 5.9207 from 5.9043.
The 364-day bills maturing on April 9, 1998 rose to 6.2691 percent from 6.2342. They were priced at 99.56250, 98.57031, 97.09375 and 94.03906 respectively.
One-month interbank rates were at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent, three months were at 5-7/8, 3/4 percent, six months were at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one-year funds were put at 6-7/16, 5/16.
